easyPrerequisites: Phantom Steed must be exiled by Changeling Berserker, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
